caseStudy.challenge: Mega Cafe needed food and beverage visuals that could make menu items feel clear, appetizing, and usable across social media, not just a basic product shoot.
caseStudy.solution: LA STRADA built a visual set around drinks, desserts, and cafe moments, then supported the stills with short-form video reels for a stronger digital presence.
caseStudy.ctaTitle: Want your menu to look as good online as it feels in-store?
caseStudy.ctaBody: LA STRADA can produce the photography and reels your brand needs for sharper social media presence.

title: Photoshoot | Mega Cafe Jordan
description: LA STRADA conducted a professional photoshoot for Mega Cafe in Jordan focused on menu items, including food, drinks, desserts, and cafe visuals. The work was designed to present products with high visual quality, strengthen the cafe's social media presence, and support its digital marketing content with both still imagery and short-form video assets.
